# TeerOnline.com

TeerOnline.com publishes Teer results, previous-result records and reference guides for Shillong, Khanapara and Juwai.

## Pages

- [Shillong Teer Result Today – FR, SR & Common Numbers | TeerOnline](https://teeronline.com/): Shillong Teer result today: FR 4:15 PM and SR 5:15 PM IST with publish times and Common Numbers, plus links to previous results and the other Teer games.
- [Shillong Teer Previous Results – Full Result History](https://teeronline.com/shillong-teer-previous-results): Shillong Teer previous results: every FR and SR on record by month, searchable by date, number or round. Today's result has its own page.

- [Responsible Play: Betting Risks and Where to Get Help in India](https://teeronline.com/guides/responsible-play): Plain facts about betting risk, questions to ask yourself, and the free national mental health helpline in India, Tele-MANAS, with its published numbers.
- [Teer Formula: Value, Groups, Points & Popular Methods](https://teeronline.com/teer-formula): House and Ending, paired values, the 15 Teer groups, points 0-18 and popular Teer formulas, explained with real worked examples. No guarantees.
- [Teer Dream Numbers List with House & Ending](https://teeronline.com/dream-numbers): A searchable list of traditional Teer dream numbers with House and Ending digits, grouped by animals, people, objects, nature, places and actions.
